obligations.name: robert_authored_reactions
obligations.description: Identify the reaction(s) left on messages authored by whichever member named Robert holds conversation membership in #core-infra; the author's channel membership (not the message's own channel) is the qualifying condition, and the reactor may differ from the author.
obligations.scope: reactions on messages authored by a user named Robert who is a member of the #core-infra channel in Test Workspace

task_spec.text: Report which reactions have been added to messages written by Robert, given his membership in #core-infra, including who reacted and with which emoji.

access_plan: Acting bot U01AGENBOT9 is already a member of #core-infra and #general, so it can call conversations.members on C_INFRA to see both Robert Walsh and Robert Chen listed, then users.info on each to confirm the shared first name. Using conversations.history/search.messages across the bot's joined channels (#general and #core-infra) locates each Robert's authored messages, and reactions.get on those specific message timestamps surfaces the reaction_type and reacting user for each candidate set.
